title: 第15章 持续投喂百倍返还大道丹第16章 一月入命轮二层胸骨孕仙王
slug: 玄幻长生神子何须妹骨证道
content_zh:
说罢。
顾长歌已经按照脑海中凝练先天太虚罡气的法门，开始孕育混沌灵光，包裹眼前的五行天材地宝。
“嗡”
一抹混沌光芒一闪而逝。
顾长歌张口一吞，五种五行天材地宝尽数入腹。
顿时，恐怖的五行之力在丹田之中激荡，将千丈灵海掀起阵阵涟漪。
不过九纹命轮一震。
这些暴躁磅礴的五行灵气硬生生被镇住了。
在顾长歌的操纵下，这些五行灵气开始按照先天太虚罡气法门运转，一开始十分生涩，这些五行灵气丝毫不为所动。
但在顾长歌强大的神魂之力牵引板之下，这些五行灵气逐渐在他的丹田中形成一个巨大的彩色旋涡，旋涡中心好似有一缕气体在酝酿。
“轰隆隆”
丹田千丈灵海激荡起磅礴浪潮。
九纹命轮更是在这一刻不断震颤，像是下一秒就要坠落那般。
顾长歌知道丹田异象虽说看起来十分危险，但他道基强悍，修为圆满，根本不可能造成根基动摇，因此这不过是先天太虚罡气即将成型的动静而已。
“凝！”
伴随着顾长歌心中冷喝。
“嗡”
一缕朦胧气体从五色旋涡中凝聚。
顾长歌内视，看到丹田中这一缕朦胧气体，这才吐了口气，双眸睁开微喜：“看样子这就是本源先天太虚罡气了。”
顾长歌说着，心念一动，本源先天太虚罡气当即化作一个圆形屏障将他牢牢包裹，再次心念一动，则是局部强化，再次心念一动，则是随心所欲，随意变形。

不过这缕本源先天太虚罡气，不到无可奈何的情况下不能使用，一旦消耗完的话，那么又得重新凝练本源先天太虚罡气。
而先天太虚罡气这门神通总共有四个层次。
采气成形、凝气成罡、炼罡成体、罡体混元
对应入门，精通，小成，大成！
每个阶段防御力自然不一样。
比如现在顾长歌就是先天太虚罡气入门阶段，采气成形，防御力最弱，当然那是对应先天太虚罡气境界来说。
但对于正常交战，采气成形再加上顾长歌底蕴，硬抗命轮境三层，或者四层攻击不在话下。
“入门了。”
“还自动护主，虽然没有自已催动防御力这么强，但关键时刻可是保命的。”
说罢。
顾长歌这才发现本来午时的光亮，已经变成了夜晚。
“看样子到第二天了，等明天早上再去找顾清秋吧。”
顾长歌继续进入修炼状态。
这个世界，天资固然重要。
但有句话说的好，勤能补拙。
任何人想要成功，都离不开努力付出。
顾长歌当然不会觉得自已已经成为神子，更是凝聚九纹命轮，突破命轮境便懈怠修行。
反而相反。
他会更加努力。
因为他的目标可不单单是帝境，而是长生永存！

帝境也不过数万年寿命。
唯有长生仙神才能俯瞰悠悠红尘。
……
一夜肉身实力再次增加十万斤，并且灵海即将抵挡一千一百丈。
content_en:
Say it.
Gu Changge has followed the method of condensing the innate Taixu Gangqi in his mind, and began to breed the chaotic aura, wrapping the five elements of heaven, materials and earthly treasures in front of him.
"Buzz"
A ray of chaotic light flashed away.
Gu Changge opened his mouth and swallowed, and all five kinds of Five Elements Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures entered his stomach.
Suddenly, the terrifying power of the five elements surged in the dantian, causing ripples in the thousand-foot spiritual sea.
However, the Nine Marks Life Wheel was shaken.
These violent and majestic Five Elements Spiritual Qi were forcibly suppressed.
Under Gu Changge's control, these five elements' spiritual energy began to operate according to the innate Taixu Gangqi method. It was very awkward at first, and these five elements' spiritual energy did not move at all.
But under Gu Changge's powerful soul power, these five elements of spiritual energy gradually formed a huge colorful vortex in his Dantian, and there seemed to be a wisp of gas brewing in the center of the vortex.
"Rumble"
The thousand-foot spiritual sea in Dantian stirred up a majestic wave.
The nine-line life wheel was trembling continuously at this moment, as if it was about to fall in the next second.
Gu Changge knew that although the dantian phenomenon looked very dangerous, his Tao foundation was strong and his cultivation was perfect, so it was impossible for his foundation to be shaken. Therefore, this was just the movement of the innate Taixu Gang Qi that was about to take shape.
"Condensation!"
Along with this, Gu Changge shouted coldly in his heart.
"Buzz"
A wisp of hazy gas condensed from the five-color vortex.
Gu Changge looked inside and saw this hazy gas in his dantian. Then he exhaled and opened his eyes with a smile: "It seems that this is the origin of the innate Taixu Gangqi."
Gu Changge said, with a thought, the original innate Taixu Gangqi immediately turned into a circular barrier to tightly wrap him. With a thought again, it was partially strengthened. With a thought again, it could be deformed at will.
However, this ray of original innate Taixu Gangqi cannot be used unless there is no alternative. Once it is consumed, the original innate Taixu Gangqi must be condensed again.
The magical power of innate Taixu Gangqi has a total of four levels.
Collect gas to form, condense gas to form a gang, refine the gang to form a body, and mix the gang body into elements
Corresponds to entry, mastery, small success, and great success!
The defense power of each stage is naturally different.
For example, Gu Changge is currently in the entry-level stage of Innate Taixu Gangqi. He collects the Qi to take shape and has the weakest defense. Of course, that corresponds to the realm of Innate Taixu Gangqi.
But for normal battles, taking the shape of Qi and Gu Changge's background, it is not a problem to resist the third or fourth level of the Fate Wheel Realm.
"Getting started."
"It also automatically protects the master. Although it is not as strong as the self-activated defense, it can save lives at critical moments."
Say it.
Only then did Gu Changge realize that the light at noon had turned into night.
"It looks like it's the next day. Let's go find Gu Qingqiu tomorrow morning."
Gu Changge continued to enter the state of cultivation.
In this world, talent is important.
But there is a saying that goes well, hard work can make up for weakness.
Anyone who wants to succeed cannot do without hard work.
Of course, Gu Changge would not feel that he had become the Son of God. He had condensed the Nine Lines Life Wheel and would slack off in cultivation after breaking through the Life Wheel realm.
On the contrary.
He will try harder.
Because his goal is not just the imperial realm, but eternal life!
The life span of the Emperor Realm is only tens of thousands of years.
Only immortal gods can overlook the world of mortals.
…
The physical strength increased by another hundred thousand kilograms overnight, and the spiritual sea was about to resist eleven hundred feet.
